ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Forehead to earth turns understanding into a bodily verdict: even powerful figures are shown flattened before the encounter.
EvidenceBody: Xiatang’s appraisal, Zisheng’s answer, Zhufeng’s departure line, and Wuzhun’s gate instruction share the same downward posture.
